consent.title: Before you start
consent.lead: merit records health data about you. German and EU law treats that as a special category, and it may only be processed if you explicitly agree to it. So this is asked once, on its own, and it is a real question.
consent.what: What you would be agreeing to
consent.whatBody: That merit may store and process your body weight, optionally your body fat percentage, what you eat, and how you train: exercises, sets, reps and weights. If you ask it to calculate a calorie target it also stores your height, date of birth, sex, activity level and goal.
consent.whyBody: Showing you your own numbers, and nothing else. There is no advertising, no tracking, no profiling, no automated decision-making, and nothing is shared with anyone or sold. Nobody else can see your entries: not other people using this app, and not the person who runs it.
consent.controlBody: You can download everything as one file at any time, and you can delete the account and everything in it at any time. Both under “account”, immediately, without asking anyone. Deleting is also how you withdraw this consent, because it is the only basis on which any of this is kept.
consent.statement: I explicitly consent to merit processing my health data as described above.
consent.failed: That did not save. Check your connection and try again.
consent.decline: If you would rather not, simply sign out. Nothing is recorded until you agree, and an account without this consent is never used.
consent.notReady: merit is not ready to be used yet: its privacy notice has not been published, so there is nothing to consent to. See docs/LEGAL-INPUTS.md.
